data.name: Naazir
data.gender_notes: Naazir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-z-r’, Naazir means observer, watcher, or protector. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the context of angels guarding and watching over believers. The name Naazir carries the meaning “Observer, Watcher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naazir usually hope their child will grow to embody observer, watcher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Naazir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer, Watcher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naazir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ناظِر
in_arabic.meaning: الناظر، المُتَعلِّم، المُستَمِع، العامل الذي يُراقَب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الناظر: هو المُتَعلِّم، المُستَمِع، العامل الذي يُراقَب في شَيء، والذي يَستَمِع لِلمَشرِعات، ويَعقِب أَمَلَهُ، ويَنظُر حَيثُ يَستَقيم. وَفي القرآن الكريم: {فَلَمّا تَجَلّى لَهُمُ بَيِّناتٌ رَأَوا مِن قَبْلِهِ لَم يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَا وَقالوا مَتَاعَ الدُّنيا حَسْبُهُمْ وَمَتَاعَ الآخِرَةِ وَضيعٌ عِندَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ عِقابٌ بَعيدٌ} [البقرة: 214].

in_urdu.name: ناظِر
in_urdu.meaning: ناظر، مطالع، مسلم، عامل جوڑا جاتا ہو، دیکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناظر: ایک مطالع، مسلم، عامل جوڑا جاتا ہو، دیکھنے والا، اس کا مطلب ہے ایک شخص جسے الله تعالیٰ نے اس دنیا اور آخرت کے لیے پوری تعلیم دی ہے، اور جو اسے پوری ذمہ داری کے ساتھ بھیجتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नाजिर
in_hindi.meaning: निरीक्षक, शिक्षार्थी, ज्ञानी, सुननेवाला, देखरेख कर्ता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाजिर: यह शब्द अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है एक व्यक्ति जो अल्लाह के नियमों की रक्षा करता है, जो अल्लाह के नियमों को समझता है और जो अल्लाह के नियमों के अनुसार काम करता है।

in_pashto.name: ناظِر
in_pashto.meaning: ناظر، دیکر، دیکرګر، پوهنځیال، امانتو لرونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ناظر: دا نوم عربي زبان له او پوهنځیالي ته ورځای، کومبيډر ته ورځای، دا پوهنځیالي ته ورځای چې پوهنځي ته ورځای، لرونکی ته ورځای، دا امانت لرونکی ته ورځای چې امانت لري.

in_english.name: Naazir
in_english.meaning: observer, learner, listener, one who does a job, one who is in charge
in_english.long_meaning: Naazir is an Arabic name that means an observer, learner, listener, one who does a job, one who is in charge. It connotes a person who is knowledgeable, wise, and obedient to Allah's commands. In Islamic tradition, Naazir is associated with qualities such as diligence, hard work, and responsibility. It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide, symbolizing a person who strives to please Allah and live a righteous life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naazir has historical roots in Islamic history and culture. In various contexts, it has been used to refer to important figures such as the Prophet's companion, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, who was referred to as "Naazir al-A'maal," which means the guardian of actions. This name highlights the importance of accountability and guardianship in Islamic society.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Naazir holds immense significance in Islamic belief. It is mentioned in the Quran several times, referring to angels guarding and watching over believers. The belief in angels as protectors and guardians is a fundamental aspect of Islamic faith. The name Naazir serves as a reminder of the presence and protection of Allah and His angels, providing comfort and peace of mind to the believer.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah records the name Naazir as a title given to the Abbasid caliph Al-Muqtadir bi-llah.
historical_references.context: The caliph's name was Naazir ad-Dawlah (Naazir of the State).

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun in his Muqaddimah mentions Naazir ibn Mardanis, a Berber general and ruler of Tunisia in the late 14th century AD.
historical_references.context: The name Naazir is a title of respect, meaning guardian or protector.
